notes.title: Bugs fixed and new items added
notes.content:
update v.1.1.3.77

[b]Bugs resolved[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the bomb was not absorbed by the player
[/list]

[b]New items[/b]

4 weapons have been added:
[list]
[*] gun
[*] rifle
[*] shotgun
[*] magno
[*] combat shotgun
[/list]

New weapons will be added in the future.

Weapons can be found in chests hidden around the map and to open them you need a common key.

Added “coin” item that drops from dead enemies

Thank you all!! :)

tags.bug: [*] Fixed the bug where the bomb was not absorbed by the player

tags.feature: Added “coin” item that drops from dead enemies

notes.title: Update v.1.1.1.68
notes.content:
[b]Small improvements were made:[/b]

[list]
[*] Now the player can jump from one shortcut to another without needing to be close to it as long as the shortcut is open.
[*] Blackheart hitbox has been fixed.
[*] The bug where the player did not receive damage from the black heart enemy was also fixed.
[/list]

Thank you all!!

tags.feature: Now the player can jump from one shortcut to another without needing to be close to it as long as the shortcut is open.

notes.title: Update v.1.1.7.52
notes.content:
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the lost items inventory was not updated in some runs.
[/list]

[b]New Item Added[/b]
[list]
[*] The new item "Machine Gun" that can be equipped in the heart has been added. The heart fires at closer targets dealing decent damage that can help with the run.
[/list]

Many thanks to all players. Have a good time. :)
